Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.
Hon'ble Kshitij Shailendra,J.
1.

The petitioners have prayed for a direction to respondent no.2 to refer his application dated 24.04.2023 purportedly under Section 64 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 to the Authority as the petitioners did not feel satisfied with the award dated 16.07.2022 passed under the provisions of the aforesaid Act.
2.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Sri Rajiv Gupta, learned Additional Chief Standing Counsel, has no objection in case direction is issued to the concerned respondent to pass appropriate orders on the said application.

sentences.text:
Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on merits, the writ petition is disposed of with direction to respondent no.2 to consider and pass appropriate orders on the application of the petitioners for making reference of the dispute relating to enhancement of compensation to the Authority under Section 64 of the Act within a period of six weeks from the date of communication of the instant order along with photostat copy of the reference application dated 24.04.2023 (Annexure No.2).
Order Date :- 15.4.2024 AKShukla/-
(Kshitij Shailendra, J.) (Manoj Kumar Gupta, J.)
